question: What cycle prices does Infrawire's in-page checkout print for the quarterly, semi-annual and annual terms of the Turkey VPS line?
why: the checkout is a JavaScript flow at console.infrawire.net behind account creation; every text route (broker read, raw fetch of the page and its chunks) reaches only the i18n strings that name the cycles, and no lane may create an account. A rendered browser session with an account would settle the annual figure of compute/infrawire.
